data.name: Meemuna
data.long_meaning: Meemuna is derived from the Arabic root word 'Ameen', which means 'faithful' or 'trustworthy'. In the Quran, Meemuna is mentioned as one of the names of Maryam (Mary), the mother of Isa (Jesus). This name signifies the tranquility and serenity that comes from having unwavering faith and trust in Allah.
